notes.title: First Playtest Update: Alpha 0.8.7
notes.content:
Hello all you tappers!

I'm happy to bring you all the Alpha 0.8.7 update! Below we've provided you with the patch notes for what came in Alpha 0.8.7.

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*]Chapter 0 has been added. These are some very introduction levels for just getting players familiar with the game!
[*]Chapter 1 has had 9 new levels added.
[*]Chapter 2 has had 11 new levels added.
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Restarting a level from the pause menu will now close the pause menu.
[*]Fixed a bug where audio can be heard for a brief moment at start-up.
[*]Scaled down some larger puzzles to prevent the UI from overlapping.
[*]Level Time Attack toggle tracks across all chapters so you won't have to disable it every time you come back into the level selection.
[/list]

We look forward to all of your feedback on the changes and new levels!
And if you're not already apart of our Discord, come [url=https://discord.gg/NszjMQ58NH]join us![/url]
